comments_data.body:
Thanks @lebaphi , but I'm not going to close it right now.

Some players were monitoring around 20 channels - and had a real challenge keeping track of new messages.  In recent days I've realised that "maximise" may just be essential to them:
* arrange channels into 3 zones
* left-hand pane full height, useful for filling in forms
* right hand has upper/lower panes - with long list of channels (tabs) in each one.

The above may allow a user to view all of their tabs, without needing the `Overflow` menu.  But, the two right-hand panes are quite small.  The `maximise` button may be useful in making a message fill the screen.

If the above is valid - then we actually just have to treat this as a user training issue (maybe including it in the walkthrough).

Closing issue.

We still have this branch/code -  but we'll wait for a stronger reason to remove the maximise button.

issues.title: Remove maximise button
issues.body:
Occasionally or accidentally, players clicked on the `maximise` button.

Since our tabs are semi-transparent (so the shiny background texture is shown), players were confused to see tabs on top of other tabs.

![screencast](https://i.gyazo.com/00898d34664f6fc49e2c323457a3662e.gif)

We can overcome this by using `"enableMaximize": false` in our flexlayout config code.

comments.body: Closing.  It currently looks like the maximise button may be useful in monitoring lots of channels.
